fact: The first integrated hospital information system in a public health centre in Togo (HopitalOS) was installed at the Notsè prefectural hospital in December 2016 and at a Lomé clinic in January 2018.
title: Evaluation du systeme d'information hospitalier integre HopitalOS au Centre Hospitalier Prefectoral de Notse, et a la Clinique Nathanaël de Lome
publisher: Journal de la Recherche Scientifique de l'Université de Lomé
